title: Everyday Phrases — Recording a Podcast
title_quote: We should start a podcast together.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎙️ 實用錄播客必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱B1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Recording a Podcast
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用錄播客情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從選題買麥克風、進棚調增益試音、開錄卡殼重錄，到剪片上傳看留言，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Recording a Podcast phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering topic planning, gear shopping, studio sound checks, recording stumbles, and publishing your first episode. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should start a podcast together.
dialogue.zh: 我們一起開一檔播客吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I've wanted that for months.
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我可想好幾個月了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What topic should we pick first?
dialogue.zh: 我們先選什麼主題好呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our listeners will relate to it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you brainstorm some episode titles?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That name sounds great to me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's short and easy to remember.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we record weekly or monthly?
dialogue.zh: 我們每週錄還是每月錄？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weekly is tough, let's try biweekly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can open, and I'll close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a theme song too?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ə θim sɔŋ tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 也許之後再說，先簡單開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll write our show description today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we need a quiet studio.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們需要一個安靜的錄音室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我表哥在市區租了一間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we borrow it this Saturday?
dialogue.zh: 這週六可以借我們用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask if the room has good acoustics.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪf ðə rum hæz ɡʊd əˈkustɪks./
dialogue.zh: 順便問房間收音好不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much does a studio cost daily?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ə ˈstudioʊ kɔst ˈdeɪli?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we email the studio to confirm?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ˈimeɪl ðə ˈstudioʊ tə kənˈfɜrm?/
dialogue.zh: 要發信跟錄音室確認訂位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We still need our own microphones.
dialogue.zh: 我們還是得買自己的麥克風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 動圈式麥克風適合小房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: USB mics are easiest to start.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need an audio interface?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 用 USB 麥克風就不用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it softens harsh P sounds.
dialogue.zh: 要買，它能減弱爆掉的 P 音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we buy a boom arm too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi baɪ ə bum ɑrm tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Headphones are next on my list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll add spare cables and a mic.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl æd spɛr ˈkeɪbəlz ænd ə maɪk./
dialogue.zh: 備用線和一支備用麥克風我也加上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we order all this?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The music store has better deals.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we return a broken mic?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we learn editing software now?
dialogue.zh: 現在就要學剪輯軟體嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we test the microphone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we invite a guest to episode one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ɪnˈvaɪt ə ɡɛst tə ˈɛpɪˌsoʊd wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 第一集要不要請位嘉賓？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 記得提我們的新節目名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her to arrive at one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 準備五個聊天重點就夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she need her own headphones?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we have a spare pair.
dialogue.zh: 不用，我們有備用的一副。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend Mike can join remotely too.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ frɛnd maɪk kæn dʒɔɪn rɪˈmɔtli tu./
dialogue.zh: 我朋友麥克也可以線上參加。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him to test the call first.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm tə tɛst ðə kɔl fɜrst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He'll meet us at the door.
dialogue.zh: 他會在門口跟我們會合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need a script outline?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should the episode be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大約三十分鐘，別再長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set a timer on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你念的時候我幫忙計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you charge all the batteries?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 都充好了，行動電源也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we just sleep well tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you at the studio then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can't wait to press record.
dialogue.zh: 我等不及要按錄音鍵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 錄音室今天看起來好小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不過牆面看起來軟軟的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clamp the arms to the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the back one, it's steadier.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name them track one and two.
dialogue.zh: 把它們命名為第一、第二軌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How is this? Testing, one two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lower the gain on your mic.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? The bars look steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把你的輸入音量調高點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How close should the mic be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fist away from your mouth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point it at your chin slightly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這個角度聽起來好點了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the P pops are gone.
dialogue.zh: 好了，P 的爆音不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, mostly from the wall.
dialogue.zh: 有一點，主要來自那面牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang the quilt on that side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much better, the sound is cleaner.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn off the fan, too loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you shut the door all the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju ʃʌt ðə dɔr ɔl ðə weɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's set up a backup track.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The phone app can record too.
dialogue.zh: 手機的錄音 App 也能錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start it before the real take.
dialogue.zh: 正式開錄前先把它啟動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 開好了，畫面顯示錄音中。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 把軟體的自動儲存打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 設好了，每兩分鐘存一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the folder to the cloud.
dialogue.zh: 再把資料夾同步到雲端。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這裡的 wifi 看起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ran a speed test, it's fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ rʌn ə spiːd tɛst, ɪts fæst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 像是第一集第一取這樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll copy both to the drive.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the room too warm now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tap the desk to test.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你知道的，敲擊聲會被錄進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's do a final sound check.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our guest will be here soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her mic and chair are all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr maɪk ænd tʃɛr ɑr ɔl sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 她的麥克風和座位都弄好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you see the record light?
dialogue.zh: 你看到錄音指示燈了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's off, we're not rolling yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He locked up behind us, right?
dialogue.zh: 他在我們身後把門鎖好了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我緊張得都快坐不住啦！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hello and welcome to our show!
dialogue.zh: 哈囉，歡迎收聽我們的節目！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我是露西，高興你來收聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那今天的主題是什麼呢，露西？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 來歡迎我們的第一位嘉賓！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please meet Ms. Lin, our teacher.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她揮手問好，但沒對著麥克風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say hello again into the mic.
dialogue.zh: 請她再對麥克風問好一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back to our main thread, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 問個能接回話題的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那個問題剛好把話帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or we can re-record that line.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr wi kæn ri rɪˈkɔrd ðæt laɪn./
dialogue.zh: 不然我們把那句話重錄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 講錯就拍一下手做記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The spike is easy to spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you speak up a little?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, let me say it again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll relax and treat it as chatting.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl rɪˈlæks ənd trit ɪt æz ˈtʃætɪŋ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never record with a sore throat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 偷偷看一眼你的提示卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 紙張的沙沙聲其實很大。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那我先把下一點背起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我一笑，那個答案就廢了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 留著吧，笑聲能拉近聽眾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她要分享一個敏感的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our second guest on yet?
dialogue.zh: 我們的第二位嘉賓上線了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check if he can hear us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 麥克，請把你的麥克風打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他的聲音現在聽起來像機器人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們是等他還是繼續錄？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We can trim his bad parts later.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn trɪm hɪz bæd pɑrts ˈleɪtər./
dialogue.zh: 他卡頓的部分之後能剪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he back on the call?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們錯過了兩分鐘精彩內容。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll ask him to redo that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 看一下時間，已經一半了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save some questions for the end.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 她的故事值得多一點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那就先刪掉你的小插曲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rude! I'll keep half of it.
dialogue.zh: 好沒禮貌！我至少留一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, do you hear that ring?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是我的，飛航模式沒開成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room next door has loud music.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum nɛkst dɔr hæz laʊd ˈmjuːzɪk./
dialogue.zh: 隔壁房間在放很大聲的音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的肚子剛剛咕嚕叫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那是你發出的吧，對不對？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll say we edited it out.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stretch, sip water, relax your jaw.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we keep the good takes?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was harder than it looks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you for joining us today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She shares daily English tips online.
dialogue.zh: 她在線上分享每日英文小訣竅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她在笑耶，我們還在錄吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, we cover study habits.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 賣個關子，說有神祕嘉賓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You'll have to wait and hear.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave a review, it helps hugely.
dialogue.zh: 也歡迎留言評論，超有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That record light is finally off.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ears ring from the headphones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our guest said we sounded pro.
dialogue.zh: 嘉賓說我們聽起來很專業。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她的原話是：快要成名了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Export it as one long file.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在把每個錯誤都找出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I found all twelve clap marks.
dialogue.zh: 我找到那十二個拍手記號了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cut the silence, keep it tight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 剪太多會聽起來斷斷續續。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 把我講砸的那整句刪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 把我們的音量統一一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你比較大聲，幫你壓一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 也把房間的低頻噪音去掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 採一段噪音樣本就搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the song with a free license.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə sɔŋ wɪð ə fri ˈlaɪsəns./
dialogue.zh: 用那首有免費授權的曲子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can use it safely.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 讓音樂在人聲下淡入淡出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這樣會變成我們的招牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we put the ads?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The render exports a small MP3 copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛndər ɪkˈspɔrts ə smɔl ˌɛm pi ˈθri ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 輸出時會附一個小的 MP3 檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在從頭到尾專心聽一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: By myself? But it's thirty minutes!
dialogue.zh: 要我一個人聽完？那可是三十分鐘耶！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I'll take the back half.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還有任何要修的地方嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trim the long pause at nine.
dialogue.zh: 把第九分鐘那段長沉默剪短。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now upload it to the host.
dialogue.zh: 現在把檔傳到託管平台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The upload bar is crawling again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two lines, one call to action.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our photo, the one by the mics.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈfoʊtoʊ, ði wʌn baɪ ðə maɪks./
dialogue.zh: 就用我們對著麥克風那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 週一晚上聽眾最愛新節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text the link to everyone we know.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ðə lɪŋk tə ˈɛvriˌwʌn wi noʊ./
dialogue.zh: 把連結傳給我們認識的所有人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 也請傳給你過去的學生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 頭一個小時，十個人收聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 十個耶！那全是我們家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They said the audio is clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們的隔音海綿沒白貼！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有個聽眾發現我們的錯字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the show notes? Fix it.
dialogue.zh: 是在節目簡介裡嗎？快改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每則留言都要有禮地回覆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 道謝會換來忠實的聽眾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Quote it in the next intro.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們真的做出了一集節目。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 從構想到上線收聽，就在今晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do we record episode two?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 已經排進行事曆，到時見。
